chapter_title: Concerning the Three Images that are in the righte
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶2.
** Three discrete
 degrees of mind
 exist
 within
 the person
 undergoing regeneration.

**
¶3.** The first
 is the in
most spiritual
 degree, which is the regenerate will
 and understanding —
 what
 divine
 wisdom itself
 forms within the interior
 man
 by
 infl
owing and
 taking
 up its
 dwelling there
.


**¶4.** The
 second degree
 is what
 remains and
 pers
ists of
 that
 regenerate life at
 the level
 of the rational
-natural mind — an
 intermediate state still
 held
 capt
ive within the proprium, still
 ent
angled with hereditary evil
,
 as
 the unre
generate will
 has
 dominated
 this
 middle
 degree
 since
 its
 origins
.

**¶5.**
 The third is
 the outermost sensory-
corporeal degree of
 the mind, which encompasses and is adjo
ined to the other two.

**
¶6.** These
 three degrees constitute
 the
 whole
 mind
.
 When the living
 substance of good and truth is taken
 in
 through the appropri
ation of spiritual nourishment, it
 descends first
 to the ou
termost sensory degree.
 There
 the
 sensory mind separates from itself what
 does not belong to its
 own nature
 and
 deposits
 it inward. Then it asc
ends again
 and
 passes
 through
 the rational-natural degree, which strips
 away from it
 the evil affections belonging
 to the external man — the
 w
rath that
 pert
ains
 to self
-love, the conc
upiscence that c
lings to it from
 the prop
rium.

**¶7.
** Then
 divine
 truth
 proce
eding from divine good —
 a
 wisdom
 in
 affectional form — comes
 and
 dis
closes the inmost spiritual degree,
 which is the regenerate will and understanding
. This
 wisdom serves
 as a leading
 truth
.
 She goes
 before,
 and the purified good
 is drawn
 up
ward into
 interior
 and
 celest
ial states,
 and
 is
 received into the in
most degree of
 the mind. There she
 forms
 it
,
 and
 invests it with the
 truths proper
 to the regenerate life within
.
 It is confirmed and
 sealed in every
 particular
 faculty of this divine wisdom, which is
 present and makes
 her
 dwelling within the regenerate will.


**¶8.** In
 this manner
 the living element of good —
 that which
 enters the external mind of the righteous
 person from the
 world
 without,
 through the appropriation of goods
 and truths of
 every
 kind — is purified and made living
. The essential
 goodness within all that is received is
 cleansed continually, day
 by
 day, and
 passes through all three degrees of the mind
.

**¶9.**
 At
 the sensory degree
 it
 separates from itself everything
 that belongs
 to the body of
 the proprium,
 which
 is not
 its own. At
 the rational-natural degree it likewise
 separates from itself the evil affections
 that have
 become
 mixed with it and
 that
 are not its own — w
rath, concupiscence, r
eck
lessness, fool
ishness, envy, and cont
ention — together
 with every
 false persuasion of the unre
generate natural
 man.

**¶10.
** But
 in the in
most spiritual
 degree itself, the purified good lives
 and is conjoined with patience,
 with
 the fullness of faith, and with
 love,
 which reigns over all other
 states
. This is divine truth from divine good
 —
 she
 who
 invests the regenerate will with tru
ths —
 and she
 is called *
the moment
 of life*
:
 she is the first principle from which all
 regeneration begins,
 and she
 is also the last state in which it
 is brought
 to completion.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three images occur in the elect person.
The first is the spiritual image, which is the new man, which the Light Mind shall form in him; and it goes into him and dwells in him.
The second image is the remnant and remainder of the new man, which is the psychic image that is bound in the flesh, as the old man [has ruled over it since the] times of this psychic image.
The other one is the corporeal image [that is] added to them all.

These three images [constitute him] entirely. When it will [enter the body] through the nourishment of food. If it shall sink [it comes first] down to the corporeal image. [And] the corporeal, [that] is in it, shall divest itself of it and place it in the [psychic] image. [Then] again it rises up and falls to the [psychic] image; it shall divest itself of the psychical of the enemies, which [are mixed with it, that is] anger. The lust [that clings to it shall also be stripped] with it.

Then shall a light virgin come and reveal the spiritual image that is [there], which [is] the new man. That virgin acts as a guide. [She g]oes on before and it is extended to the heights above, and received into this spiritual image. And she [sculpts] it and adorns it with the new man [wi]thin. It is sealed with all the limbs of this light virgin who is present and dwells in the new man.

So, this is [h]ow this living limb shall be [puri]fied and live, the one that comes into the body of [the ri]ghteous one from without through the administration of food of various ki[nds], like this. The living soul shall be clea[n]sed entirely every [d]ay and traverse these three [im]a[ges].

So, it shall divest itself of the body, which is not its own, in the corporeal. It shall also divest itself of the souls that are not its own, these that are mixed with it in the psychical [image, that is] anger and desire and [reckless]-ness and foolishness and envy and strife; and these other wicked teachings that are not its own.

However, in [the] spiritual image itself it shall live and be joined with [lo]ng-sufferingness, the perfection of faith and love that reigns over them all. It is the virgin of light who robes the new man and who shall be cal[l]ed ‘the hour of life’. S[he] is the f[irst], but s[h]e is also the last.
